run_gmock_gen: run gmock_gen.py on a C++ header file to generate Google Mock classes for all classes
run_gmock_gen_class: run gmock_gen.py on a header file targeting specific class names to generate mock classes
generate_mock_classes: generate Google Mock class code from a C++ header file and output to stdout
review_gmock_class_main: review the gmock_class main function that parses C++ headers and generates mock class output
summarize_gmock_gen_driver: summarize the gmock_gen.py driver script that imports and delegates to gmock_class.main
